1365-2198-2527-5231-5294.easyPrerequisites:
Deceiver Exarch doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vohar doesn't have summoning sickness.
1365-2198-2527-5231-5294.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Repeat.

147-803-8200.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Grub's Command
147-803-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Grub's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Grub's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-803-8200.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

141-728-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-728-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2105-5778-7297-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

6495-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
6495-6871-6879-7298.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-5686-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-6719.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3755-4222-7937.description:
Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

3617-4823-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Timeless Witness.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Timeless Witness from exile to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1283-2341-2495.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Chromatic Orrery and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Chromatic Orrery and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

527-549-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-549-1978.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat

3200-4195-4574-5849.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Urza's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2173-3661-3967-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2736-2921-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

883-2173-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3430-4222.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}, and Freed from the Real is attached to that creature.
3430-4222.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

632-3621-4659-5129-5223.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-5129-5223.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4798-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
392-4798-5632.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers. Holding priority, activate Harnfel by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
Repeat from step 2.

307-1741-4520-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Silver-Fur Master and Cloud of Faeries do not have summoning sickness.
You control an additional creature that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Silver-Fur Master, Cloud of Faeries or the additional creature.
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
307-1741-4520-5241.description:
Declare Silver-Fur Master, Cloud of Faeries and an additional creature as an attacker.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima's Student's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning the additional creature from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand on the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Cloud of Faeries.
When Sakashima's Student enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U}{U} and returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Silver-Fur Master that is tapped and attacking.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time, returning Thousand-Faced Shadow to your hand instead.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{U} and returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 8.
307-1741-4520-5241.notes: You may start the combo with Thousand-Faced Shadow on the battlefield. If you do, replace any mention of the "additional creature" with Thousand-Faced Shadow instead.

618-2292-4142.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

28-2232-2506-4033-5037.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
28-2232-2506-4033-5037.description:
Activate Sadistic Hypnotist by sacrificing a creature, causing you to discard Basking Rootwalla and Blazing Rootwalla into exile.
Basking Rootwalla and Blazing Rootwalla's madness abilities trigger.
Resolve the Basking Rootwalla trigger, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
When Basking Rootwalla enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Basking Rootwalla with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Basking Rootwalla from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blazing Rootwalla trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Repeat steps 4 through 7 one additional time using Blazing Rootwalla instead.
Repeat from step 1.

2511-2867-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1045-4050-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one red card in hand.
1045-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Horde Ambusher, adding one mana of any color.
When Horde Ambusher dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Horde Ambusher from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Horde Ambusher's morph ability by revealing a red card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

3306-4068-4803-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control at least one Mountain.
3306-4068-4803-5261.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Slip On The Ring without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Slip On The Ring, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Repeat.

1217-2232-2421-2459-4050.notablePrerequisites: Rograkh and You have enough mana to pay for Rograkh's commander tax, if applicable.
1217-2232-2421-2459-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {W}.
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Yoshimaru to your hand from the battlefield.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Yoshimaru by paying {1}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
When Yoshimaru enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

3098-3120-3449-5195.notablePrerequisites: Mindsplice Apparatus has at least two oil counters on it.
3098-3120-3449-5195.description:
Cast Déjà Vu by paying {U}, targeting Call to Mind.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Déjà Vu, returning Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {U}, targeting Déjà Vu.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Call to Mind, returning Déjà Vu from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

702-2697-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
702-2697-3976.description:
Cast Last Chance by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Last Chance and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Stunning Reversal and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Move to your next turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with both face down creatures, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to cast a copy of Last Chance without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Last Chance, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to cast a copy of Stunning Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Stunning Reversal.
At the beginning of your end step, Last Chance triggers, causing your life total to become one and you to draw seven cards due to Stunning Reversal.
Repeat from step 4.

66-1558-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Artificer Class triggers, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere.
The Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Myr Battlesphere token and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

95-781.description: Cast Traumatize by paying its mana cost, causing an opponent to mill a number of cards equal to half their library, rounded down, times two due to Bruvac.
95-781.notes: If the targeted opponent(s) has an odd number of cards in their library, they will have one card remaining. If they have an even number, they will mill their entire library. You can also target yourself, if desired, to mill half your library.

2349-2724-3987.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Mistmeadow Witch. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

914-3089.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3089.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {R} and three mana of any color.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Dockside Extortionist to hand.
Repeat.
